# Wave Laboratory: appendix {.page-title}

[Verification notes · 30 October 2026]{.kicker}

Checked against `Exios66/wave-laboratory` `4c7354e` on 30 October 2026.

## Counts

174 commits, 1 October 2026 through 24 October 2026. 472 `it(` calls in 61 `src/**/*.test.ts` files. 25 validation tests, unchanged. Browser tests: 22 `test(` calls in `e2e/app.spec.ts` and 5 in `e2e/mobile.spec.ts`.

`pnpm dev` prints a local Vite URL. That address is the dev server, not a page on this site.

## Figures

Six figures still hash-match the source `docs/screenshots/` tree as of the 29 October audit. Three portfolio-only captures (overview light, overview dark, rogue wave) predate the 9–24 October scenery merges and were not re-rendered for this pass. Treat them as earlier captures.
